name: Particle Editor v1.0
author: Dominik Koperkiewicz
description: An editor for the author's WASM-4 particle system: design effects with the mouse, zoom and pan the view, then export the settings. Hold Z and move to set the emitter area.

descriptions.en: An editor for the author's WASM-4 particle system: design effects with the mouse, zoom and pan the view, then export the settings. Hold Z and move to set the emitter area.
descriptions.it: Editor per il sistema di particelle WASM-4 dell'autore: crea effetti col mouse, sposta e ingrandisci la vista ed esporta le impostazioni. Tieni Z e muovi per l'area di emissione.
